Title: Exp 1: Industry Naming Conventions & Refactoring (The Account Class)
Description:
Objective:
Refactor the non-compliant Account class and test driver to strictly follow Google Java Style naming conventions:
• Replace non-compliant fields/variables (acc_id, bal_amt, ann_rate, w_amt, d_amt) with exact lowerCamelCase names (id, balance, annualInterestRate, withdrawAmount, depositAmount).
• Rename methods (Get_Monthly_Rate, Get_Monthly_Int, Withdraw_Amt, Deposit_Amt) to lowerCamelCase (getMonthlyInterestRate, getMonthlyInterest, withdraw, deposit).
• Convert hardcoded values into private static final UPPER_SNAKE_CASE constants.

Account Class Specification:
• private int id (default 0), private float balance (default 100), private float annualInterestRate (default 0).
• Constructors: Account() and Account(int id, float balance, float annualInterestRate).
• Accessor & mutator methods for id, balance, and annualInterestRate.
• getMonthlyInterestRate() -> (annualInterestRate / 100.0f) / 12.0f
• getMonthlyInterest() -> balance * getMonthlyInterestRate()
• withdraw(float amount) and deposit(float amount)
• Test Program: id = 1122, balance = $20,000, annualInterestRate = 4.5%, withdraw $2,500, deposit $3,000, and print id, balance, monthly interest rate, and monthly interest.

Input Format:
id (int), balance (float), annualInterestRate (float), withdrawAmount (float), depositAmount (float)
Output Format:
Account ID: <id>
Balance: <2_decimals>
Monthly Interest Rate: <5_decimals>
Monthly Interest: <2_decimals>
Public Output:
Account ID: 1122
Balance: 20500.00
Monthly Interest Rate: 0.00375
Monthly Interest: 76.88
Private Output:
Account ID: 1001
Balance: 9000.00
Monthly Interest Rate: 0.00500
Monthly Interest: 45.00
